get.description: Standalone Lending workflow using explicit operator jurisdiction labels and whole-term flat charge terms, not APR. Approval requires a distinct decision maker and a valid first due date. No compliance, disbursement, repayment or account balance is asserted. Submitted terms are immutable; exact integer allocation conserves principal and charges.

202.description: Durable command accepted; poll its private result receipt

403.description: Current membership, role or entitlement denied

404.description: Record unavailable in this organization and visibility scope

x-completed-result.description: Versioned product/application with model-owned options, bounded data/meta page, or approved immutable schedule with integer principal_minor/charge_minor/total_minor and numbered due dates. Whole-term charge is rounded up once; each total is allocated by quotient and remainder.
